slides.texte_overlay:
things that instantly make
you more interesting

a strange hobby

pick up one unusual hobby, like fencing, beekeeping or calligraphy. people are always curious about someone with a hobby they've never even heard of before.

opinions about books

read a few books that truly move you and form real thoughts about them. people love talking to someone who reads widely and actually thinks about what they read.

knowing odd facts

odd facts are the easiest way to become interesting, and you only need 5 minutes a day to collect them. one surprising fact can carry a whole conversation.
slides.texte_sophia:
knowing odd facts

i spend 5 minutes a day learning one odd fact, like why cats purr. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and odd facts are the easiest way to become interesting.

slides.texte_overlay:
telling stories well

practise telling short stories with a beginning, a twist and an ending. a good storyteller is magnetic at any table, and it's a skill anyone can learn.

real curiosity about people

ask people about their lives and genuinely listen. the most interesting people are almost always the ones most interested in everyone else around them.
